cases.sentence: ___ эта после тщательной отделки была издана в прошлом году и разослана книгопродавцам.
cases.translation: This book, after careful polishing, was published last year and sent out to booksellers.
cases.explain: Книга is the grammatical subject of была издана (was published), so it is in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Книга эта после тщательной ___и была издана в прошлом году.
cases.translation: This book, after careful polishing, was published last year.
cases.explain: The preposition после (after) governs the genitive case.
Книгопродавцам is the indirect object of разослана (sent out to), which takes the dative case.
Желание is the direct object of выразило (expressed); this inanimate neuter noun has the same form as the nominative.

cases.sentence: Его шестилетнее произведение, выработанное с такой любовью и ___ом, прошло бесследно.
cases.translation: His six years' work, produced with such love and labor, passed without a trace.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses the means/manner — 'produced with such love and labor.'

cases.translation: A strong stir in the scholarly world.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating a sphere governs the prepositional case.

reading.question: How much time had passed as the chapter begins?
reading.explain: The chapter opens with "Прошло почти два месяца" (almost two months had passed).

reading.ru: Уже с год тому назад была кончена его книга «Плод шестилетнего труда», а заглавленная «Опыт обзора основ и форм государственности в Европе и в России».
reading.question: What was the title of Sergei Ivanovich's book?
options: "An Essay Reviewing the Foundations and Forms of Statehood in Europe and Russia"
reading.correct: "An Essay Reviewing the Foundations and Forms of Statehood in Europe and Russia"
reading.explain: The book, finished about a year earlier, was titled "Опыт обзора основ и форм государственности в Европе и в России."

reading.ru: Но все-таки Сергей Иванович ожидал, что книга его появлением своим должна будет произвести серьезное впечатление на общество, и если не переворот в науке, то во всяком случае сильное волнение в ученом мире.
reading.question: What impact did Sergei Ivanovich expect his book to make?
options: A serious impression on society, if not a revolution in science, then at least a stir in the scholarly world
reading.correct: A serious impression on society, if not a revolution in science, then at least a stir in the scholarly world
reading.explain: He expected the book to produce a serious impression, or at least a strong stir in the scholarly world.

reading.ru: Но прошла неделя, другая, третья, и в обществе не было заметно никакого впечатления.
reading.question: What happened in society after several weeks passed?
options: No impression from the book was noticeable at all
reading.correct: No impression from the book was noticeable at all
reading.explain: After a week, then another, then a third, no impression whatsoever was noticeable in society.

reading.ru: Только в «Северном жуке» в шуточном фильетоне о певце Драбанте, спавшем с голоса, было, кстати, сказано несколько презрительных слов о книге Кознышева, показывавших, что книга эта уже давно осуждена всеми и предана на всеобщее посмеяние.
reading.question: How was the book first mentioned in print?
options: With a few contemptuous words, in passing, in a humorous feuilleton in "The Northern Beetle"
reading.correct: With a few contemptuous words, in passing, in a humorous feuilleton in "The Northern Beetle"
reading.explain: Only in a comic feuilleton about a singer, in "Северный жук," were a few contemptuous words said about the book, in passing.

reading.ru: Наконец, на третий месяц в серьезном журнале появилась критическая статья.
reading.question: What happened in the third month?
options: A critical article about the book appeared in a serious journal
The book was translated into French
Sergei Ivanovich published a second edition
The book was awarded a prize
reading.correct: A critical article about the book appeared in a serious journal
reading.explain: At last, in the third month, a critical article appeared in a serious journal.

reading.ru: Автор статьи был очень молодой и больной филиетонист, очень бойкий как писатель, но чрезвычайно малообразованный и робкий в отношениях личных.
reading.question: How is the author of the critical article described?
options: Very young and sickly, lively as a writer but poorly educated and timid in person
A close personal friend of Sergei Ivanovich
reading.correct: Very young and sickly, lively as a writer but poorly educated and timid in person
reading.explain: The article's author is described as a very young, sickly feuilletonist, lively as a writer but very poorly educated and shy in personal relations.

reading.ru: И все это было так остроумно, что Сергей Иванович сам бы не отказался от такого остроумия.
reading.question: What did Sergei Ivanovich privately think of the article's wit?
options: That it was so clever he himself would not have refused such wit
That it was too long to read
reading.correct: That it was so clever he himself would not have refused such wit
reading.explain: He admits to himself that the article was so witty that he would not have declined such wit himself.

reading.ru: «Не обидел ли я его чем-нибудь?» – спрашивал себя Сергей Иванович.
reading.question: What question does Sergei Ivanovich ask himself after reading the review?
options: Whether he had offended the author in some way
Whether he should sue the journal
Whether the critic was paid off
reading.correct: Whether he had offended the author in some way
reading.explain: He asks himself, "Did I not offend him in some way?"

reading.ru: И Сергей Иванович видел, что его шестилетнее произведение, выработанное с такой любовью и трудом, прошло бесследно.
reading.question: How does Sergei Ivanovich feel about his six years of work after the article?
options: That it had passed without leaving any trace
That it had made him famous
reading.correct: That it had passed without leaving any trace
reading.explain: He saw that his six years' work, produced with such love and labor, had passed without a trace.

reading.ru: Сергей Иванович был умен, образован, здоров, деятелен и не знал, куда употребить всю свою деятельность.
reading.question: How is Sergei Ivanovich's character summed up?
options: Intelligent, educated, healthy, and energetic, but unsure how to direct his energy
reading.correct: Intelligent, educated, healthy, and energetic, but unsure how to direct his energy
reading.explain: The text says he was clever, educated, healthy, energetic, and did not know where to put all his energy.

reading.ru: На его счастье, в это самое тяжелое для него, по причине неудачи его книги «Время», на смену вопросов иноверцев, американских друзей, самарского голода, выставки, спиритизма, стал славянский вопрос, прежде только тлевшийся в обществе.
reading.question: What new cause emerged just as Sergei Ivanovich was most discouraged?
options: The Slavic question, which had previously only smoldered in society
reading.correct: The Slavic question, which had previously only smoldered in society
reading.explain: Fortunately for him, the Slavic question, which had only smoldered before, now took the place of earlier preoccupations.

reading.ru: Он посвятил всего себя на служение этому великому делу и забыл думать о своей книге.
reading.question: What did Sergei Ivanovich do once he devoted himself to the Slavic cause?
options: He gave himself entirely to serving it and forgot about his book
He abandoned it after a week
He wrote another book about it
He left Russia to join the fighting
reading.correct: He gave himself entirely to serving it and forgot about his book
reading.explain: He devoted his whole self to serving this great cause and forgot to think about his book.

reading.ru: Проработав всю весну и часть лета, он только в июле месяца собрался поехать в деревню к брату.
reading.question: When did Sergei Ivanovich finally set out to visit his brother in the country?
options: Only in July, after working through spring and part of summer
reading.correct: Only in July, after working through spring and part of summer
reading.explain: Having worked all through spring and part of summer, he only got ready to go to the country to his brother in July.
